candidate.user_submission: Pikin na 18 months old. Im get cough or e dey breathe with wahala. Im nor get diarrhoea. Im nor get ear wahala. Im nor get fever. E nor dey convulse now. Im never get convulsion before. Im nor dey weak or dey like say e no dey conscious. E fit drink or breastfeed. E nor dey vomit everything. We count im breathe for one minute. For when pikin calm, im chest nor dey go inside. Na 3 days the cough don last. Im oxygen level na 89.9%. Pulse oximeter dey available. Im nor dey get recurrent wheeze. Im breathing rate na 35. For when im calm, im nor dey get stridor. Im nor dey wheeze.
